Use when writing, reviewing, or refactoring code to avoid overcomplication, make surgical changes, surface assumptions, and define verifiable success criteria.\nlicense: MIT\n---\n\n# Karpathy Guidelines\n\nBehavioral guidelines to reduce common LLM coding mistakes, derived from [Andrej Karpathy's observations](https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876) on LLM coding pitfalls.\n\n**Tradeoff:** These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks, use judgment.\n\n## 1. Think Before Coding\n\n**Don't assume. Don't hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.**\n\nBefore implementing:\n- State your assumptions explicitly. If uncertain, ask.\n- If multiple interpretations exist, present them - don't pick silently.\n- If a simpler approach exists, say so. Push back when warranted.\n- If something is unclear, stop. Name what's confusing. Ask.\n\n## 2. Simplicity First\n\n**Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.**\n\n- No features beyond what was asked.\n- No abstractions for single-use code.\n- No \"flexibility\" or \"configurability\" that wasn't requested.\n- No error handling for impossible scenarios.\n- If you write 200 lines and it could be 50, rewrite it.\n\nAsk yourself: \"Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated?\" If yes, simplify.\n\n## 3. Surgical Changes\n\n**Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.**\n\nWhen editing existing code:\n- Don't \"improve\" adjacent code, comments, or formatting.\n- Don't refactor things that aren't broken.\n- Match existing style, even if you'd do it differently.\n- If you notice unrelated dead code, mention it - don't delete it.\n\nWhen your changes create orphans:\n- Remove imports/variables/functions that YOUR changes made unused.\n- Don't remove pre-existing dead code unless asked.\n\nThe test: Every changed line should trace directly to the user's request.\n\n## 4. Goal-Driven Execution\n\n**Define success criteria. Loop until verified.**\n\nTransform tasks into verifiable goals:\n- \"Add validation\" → \"Write tests for invalid inputs, then make them pass\"\n- \"Fix the bug\" → \"Write a test that reproduces it, then make it pass\"\n- \"Refactor X\" → \"Ensure tests pass before and after\"\n\nFor multi-step tasks, state a brief plan:\n```\n1. [Step] → verify: [check]\n2. [Step] → verify: [check]\n3. [Step] → verify: [check]\n```\n\nStrong success criteria let you loop independently. Weak criteria (\"make it work\") require constant clarification.\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

`desktop/src/modules/agent/index.tsx`\\n- `desktop/src/app-shell/navigation.ts`\\n\\n## Impact\\n正常使用“发送并跳转”时，如果 Agent 模块刷新会话失败、选择会话失败或发送消息失败，用户只会看到弹窗关闭并切到 Agent 页，但提示词没有发出去，也没有错误提示。相比“后台发送”分支会在 `bridge.agent.send(...).catch` 中 toast “发送失败”，跳转分支缺少等价反馈。\\n\\n## Scope Check\\n`rg \\\"requestOpenAgentSession|pendingAgentSession|onPendingAgentSessionConsumed|prompt\\\" desktop/src/app-shell desktop/src/modules/agent -g '!**/*.test.*'` 确认 prompt handoff 由 `AgentModule` 异步消费。`rg \\\"Prompt run|发送并跳转|pending-session-handoff|toast.error\\\" desktop/src/modules/prompts desktop/src/modules/agent -g '!**/*.test.*'` 显示后台发送有 `toast.error(\\\"发送失败\\\")`，但 pending-session handoff 的 catch 只有日志。\\n\\n## Suggested Fix\\n让 pending Agent session handoff 失败时显示用户可见错误，并考虑只在 `chat.selectSession`/`chat.sendMessage` 成功后消费 pending 状态；Prompt 侧也可以等待一个可观察的 handoff 结果后再关闭弹窗。\\n\\n## Notes\\n- Reported by: agent-20260517T172253Z-yltp\\n- Scan time: 2026-05-17T17:22:53Z\\n- Local Summary\n定时任务手动触发期间，运行按钮不会进入本地 pending/disabled 状态，用户连续点击会产生 skipped 运行记录并看到“触发失败”。\n\n## Priority\n- Priority: P2\n- Type: interaction\n- Direction: C\n- Estimated complexity: small\n\n## Evidence\n触发入口 → 用户点击任务卡片的运行按钮 → \"'`desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/components/task-card.tsx:188` 只在 `disabled || busy || activeRunning` 时禁用按钮，`desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/components/task-card.tsx:189` 直接调用 `onRun` → `desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/index.tsx:377` 把 `onRun` 接到 `handleRunTask(task)` → `desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/index.tsx:258` 的 `handleRunTask` 不调用 `runMutation`，也没有设置 `busy` 或每任务 pending 状态 → 首次 `runTask(task.id)` 在 `desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/index.tsx:267` 返回前，或返回后列表刷新前，当前卡片的 `activeRunning` 仍来自旧的 `task.activeRun` → 再次点击会进入主进程 → `desktop/electron/services/task-scheduler/task-scheduler-service.ts:229` 检测到任务已在运行后调用 `recordSkipped`，`desktop/electron/services/task-scheduler/task-scheduler-service.ts:230` 写入 skipped 运行记录 → renderer 因 `isAcceptedManualRun` 不接受 skipped，在 `desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/index.tsx:282` 展示“触发失败”。\n\n## Code References\n- `desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/components/task-card.tsx:188`\n- `desktop/electron/services/task-scheduler/run-repository.ts`\n\n## Impact\n这是普通双击或网络/IPC 稍慢时会遇到的路径。用户已经成功触发任务后，第二次点击会被记录为 skipped，并收到“触发失败”，运行历史也会多出一条无意义的跳过记录，干扰后续排查真实失败。\n\n## Scope Check\n`rg -n activeRunning\\\\\\\\}|handleRunTask|runTask\\\\\\\\(task\\\\\\\\.id\\\\\\\\)|setBusy\\\" desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/components/task-card.tsx desktop/src/modules/task-scheduler/index.tsx\"'` \"定时任务 手动触发 按钮 未锁定 OR 定时任务 重复触发 跳过记录 OR handleRunTask activeRun busy\"` 查过，未发现同 fingerprint 或同标题问题。\n\n## Suggested Fix\n给 `handleRunTask` 增加每任务 pending 状态或复用 mutation busy，并在成功触发后刷新任务列表或乐观标记
